deadline_text_verbatim: Die berufsbegleitenden sowie die internationalen und englischsprachigen Master-Studiengänge haben besondere Bewerbungstermine.
source_authority_note: uni-stuttgart.de fails looksOfficial() (no .edu/.ac./.gov suffix) — this is the institution's own official page. Needs the officialDomains-provenance fix documented in source-authority-gap.md, not a lowered evidence bar.
limitations: This record is a pointer, not a date: continuing-education, international and English-language Master's programmes each publish their own deadline rather than following one central date.
researcher_notes: Concrete per-programme deadlines were retrieved from the consolidated official index at https://www.uni-stuttgart.de/en/study/application/master/admission/ and are recorded as DL-2026-08-21-STU0011 through STU0017 below. Note this general claim is only PARTIALLY accurate: several English-taught programmes (Computational Linguistics — STU0016/STU0017; and, per the same source page though not separately recorded here, English and American Studies and Materials Science) actually use the SAME standard May15-Jul15/Dec1-Jan15 dates as German-taught Master's, contradicting a literal reading of 'special' (besondere) for those specific programmes. Others (INFOTECH, WASTE, Chemical Sciences, IUSD) genuinely do differ from the standard dates.

limitations: No year stated.
